_comment: Kernel machine authority for conditional app-quality packs. Each pack is a first-class rule leaf under src/rules/packs/ plus this kernel entry (id, trigger, rule_leaf, evidence). The resolver is the SOLE loader: a pack activates only when (path-routes union scoper-tags) intersect execution-allowlist selects it - path_globs/risk_tags here describe what a pack RESPONDS to, and the repo's pack_routes in execution.yaml is the allowlist that gates activation. Every pack MUST carry a trigger (path_globs and/or risk_tags); a pack present without a trigger FAILS the gate. The resolver copies no leaf body and writes no artifact.

packs.evidence: App started and the changed view exercised in a browser; screenshots; responsive + accessibility passes; loading/error/empty/populated states each shown. Missing UI tooling is residual risk, not green.
Keyboard-only walkthrough with visible focus order; accessibility checker run on the changed view; contrast/labeling confirmed. Missing checker is residual risk, not green.

Contract verified against the authoritative schema/spec (not a fixture); endpoint exercised against a running instance (happy + primary error path); backward-compatibility confirmed or the break called out.
Positive AND denial paths exercised (an unauthorized actor is refused); no secret in diff/logs/output; relevant injection/encoding class checked. Unverified authorization is residual risk, not green.
Migration applied AND rolled back cleanly against a real non-production database; re-run proves idempotency; data-loss/backfill impact stated. Unrun migration is residual risk, not green.
targeted_test (and full_test when dispatched) run green with command/exit code/proof; new failure case fails before and passes after; no test silently disabled.
Changed path measured against the prior baseline (not a guess); contended path exercised under load or a race/sanitizer pass; any regression stated with its tradeoff.
Change previewed without mutating the live target (--dry-run/plan/smoke); rollback path named and available; live apply only on explicit authorization, then post-apply state confirmed.
